action.title: test_skill has hard claude binary dependency with no pre-flight check
action.description: The test_skill skill requires a `claude` binary to run tests via `claude -p`. However, test.sh does NOT check for claude availability before attempting to run tests — it simply calls `claude` and relies on the shell to error out. In environments where claude is not installed (e.g., minimal containers, CI runners without claude), test.sh produces no useful output and generates no test record, silently failing. There is no graceful fallback or pre-flight dependency check.
action.reproduction: 1. On a system without claude installed: `which claude` returns empty. 2. Run test.sh on any skill: `claude -p ...` fails with command-not-found. 3. No test record is generated, no error is raised to the caller (set -e may exit but silently). 4. The agent cannot post to trade without a test_id, grinding the economy to a halt.
